title: Google announces $5 mn funding for IIT Kharagpur for advanced AI research
description:
Technology giant Google on Saturday said it will provide IIT Kharagpur with USD 5 million, about Rs 46 crore, to develop and accelerate advanced AI research.
Speaking on the 75th anniversary of IIT Kharagpur, Director Suman Chakraborty said that the fund support for applied AI research has been envisaged by the institute's alumnus and Google CEO Sundar Pichai.
"Google is providing the Indian Institute of Technology Kharagpur (IIT Kharagpur) with USD 5 million in funding to help develop and accelerate advanced AI research, while cultivating India's next generation of scientific and technical talent," the company said in a blog.
The funding will support the institute's researchers and students across three core pillars, comprising advanced AI research, educational opportunities and AI capacity building.
